subject: English
question_text: Complete the following passage using suitable connectors:
stimulus: “Where there is a will there is a way.” This proverb is quite true. People hate their fate (a) ____ they cannot get the result as their wishes. But (b) ____ a man works deliberately for building his future, success will touch him definitely. There is no magic power, (c) ____ it is the magic of hard- work. (d) ____ one gets success, fortune will side him too. The unlucky people rebuke the fate. (e) ____, there is no alternative to work.
guide_solution: Complete with connectors: (a) because (b) when (c) but (d) When (e) Therefore
